summary: Sealed rugby club car park beside playing fields; homes only across the road.
reasons: Open sealed car park, no gate seen
Backs onto sports fields and verge
Homes more than 25 m away, across road

drivers.seclusion: Fields to the south, a grass verge and road to the north; nearest homes are across the road, about 30 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with marked bays opens straight onto the street; plenty of room to park fully off the road.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street plus club-day traffic; little at night.
drivers.convention: Club car park with a couple of cars parked; no campervans seen.

flags: Pin itself is on a steep wooded bank, 12.9% mean in DEM; the car park is the real place
Townhouses about 25 m east of the pin, near the car park's east end
Floodlit fields and club activity on training nights
sun_shade: Open car park, sun all day; eucalypts shade the north-west side in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Slope of the car park itself, which is not sampled in the DEM
Parking signs or time limits on site

best_section.where: West end of the sealed car park north of the rugby clubhouse, 40-100 m west of the pin
